in_sanskrit.name: चैत्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chaitra is derived from the Sanskrit word 'चैत्र' (chaitra), which means 'Spring, Beginning, New'. In Hindu calendar, Chaitra is the first month of the New Year, and it is also associated with the Hindu goddess Chaitanyaa, who represents the divine consciousness.

During this time, various Hindu festivals such as Holi, Ram Navami, and Hanuman Jayanti are celebrated, marking the arrival of Spring and the renewal of life. The name is also used for naming children born during this auspicious month.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Chaitra is rooted in deep spiritual meaning. It is believed that invoking the name of Chaitanya, the goddess of most auspicious beginnings, brings blessings of prosperity, happiness, and new opportunities. The name is said to represent purity, growth, and the dawn of new hopes and dreams. In Hinduism, Chaitra symbolizes hope, renewal, and the beginning of a new journey towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.
